name: Yusuf Vora
bio: Yusuf waits out poor cloth prices aboard the Safa. He sells a few bales at a time so that small buyers can bid without going through a rival house.
notes: fact: Gujarat supplied cloth carried to Melaka by Gujarati traders (docs/research/commodities.md, Cloth; Tomé Pires, Suma Oriental, Cortesão ed., vols. I–II)
gameplay: The Safa is the Cambay fleet's cloth nau; Yusuf wants pepper for the westbound passage, not a quick sale for coin (data/briefings/day_04_rumours_from_the_west.json)

gameplay: Let him split the state purchase into smaller lots and he opens his bidding to Arulan; tie up his berth for a full valuation and he offers his remaining cloth in Pasai instead (docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§07–09)
